c74object.name: mc.ear.hoa~
c74object.category: spatial audio, ADM, ambisonics, audio, mc
c74object.digest: Decode an ambisonic scene (ADM HOA) to loudspeaker signals with libear (ITU-R BS.2127), with multichannel signal input and output
c74object.description: Decode an ambisonic scene (ADM HOA) to loudspeaker signals with libear (ITU-R BS.2127), with multichannel signal input and output. The input carries the ambisonic components in ACN order (W Y Z X ... for first order); the output has one channel per loudspeaker of the BS.2051 layout given as argument. The decoder is the EAR's AllRAD design for that layout. Sum the output with mc.ear.objects~ and mc.ear.direct~ rendering to the same layout to mix scene-based, object-based and channel-based audio.

method.name: align
method.description: Set the align attribute. Delay the output by the latency of the object renderers (255 samples, the BS.2127 decorrelator compensation delay) so that the scene stays time-aligned with mc.ear.objects~ and ear.objects~ when their decorrelation is on, as the EAR reference renderer does. Turn off for zero latency when no decorrelating renderer is mixed in.

method.name: channels
method.digest: Post the channel names of the output layout to the Max console
method.description: Post the channel names of the output layout to the Max console.

method.name: components
method.digest: Post the ambisonic components expected on the input channels (ACN index, order and degree) to the Max console
method.description: Post the ambisonic components expected on the input channels (ACN index, order and degree) to the Max console.

method.name: layout
method.description: Set the layout attribute. ITU-R BS.2051 output layout name, fixed at creation (give it as argument).

method.name: normalization
method.description: Set the normalization attribute. Normalization of the ambisonic components: SN3D (the ADM default, also AmbiX), N3D or FuMa.

method.name: order
method.description: Set the order attribute. Ambisonic order of the input scene, 0 to 8. The input has (order+1)^2 channels in ACN order; a new channel count takes effect when the audio is restarted.

method.name: ramp
method.description: Set the ramp attribute. Gain interpolation time in milliseconds when the order or normalization changes.
